analysis: Changes reviewed: docs/reference/configuration.md (date bump at line 3 and a new row at line 324 documenting DARKBLOOM_TTFT_GDN_BLOCKED) and the libs/mlx-swift-lm submodule pointer bump (19634dd -> f4be1ba). The doc change is documentation only. The new env var selects a Gated DeltaNet prompt-window kernel (probe, stock, packed or rows). The documentation says it is read once per process and not forwarded to LaunchAgents, so an installed daemon cannot be steered through the launchd environment. A local operator who controls the process environment is already inside the TB-003/ADV-001 model. The documentation states that the default probe only keeps the four-row kernel where it reproduces gated_delta_step bit for bit, and that forced kernels skip that check and are for A/B measurement only. That is a correctness knob, not a confidentiality or authorization control, and it does not touch attestation, encryption, prefix-cache storage (T-041), App Attest authorization (TB-011), or the coordinator boundary. The submodule bump contains the code that implements the new kernel selection. Its contents are not supplied; only the pointer change is visible. I cannot verify that the kernel change is free of memory-safety problems, output-correctness regressions (T-007/T-027-type integrity concerns), or changes to cache/KV handling, and I cannot verify the doc's claims about kernel behavior. Remaining question for integration: review the submodule diff (GatedDelta.swift and any other files) between the two commits. Otherwise there are no concrete findings from the supplied evidence.
